items.title: Why Is Everyone Ignoring Adobe Stock's High Cash Yield?
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) stock now trades about 58% below its two-year high, set in December 2024. Free cash flow is the cash left after running costs and spending on equipment. At that price, Adobe's yearly free cash flow equals 11.5% of its market value. The median S&P 500 company's free cash flow equals 4.5% of its market value. items.title: Oracle Shares Fall 1.8% After Report Flags Potential Wisconsin AI Data Centre Delays
Oracle shares slip on unconfirmed report of delays at Wisconsin AI mega-campus
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oracle Corp. shares slipped Wednesday after a new report warned that the software giant’s massive artificial-intelligence data-center project in Wisconsin faces severe delays due to a gridlocked power connection.

items.title: Michael Burry Swapped Shorts for Micron Puts Struck Near Half the Share Price
items.summary: Michael Burry just swapped unlimited-horizon short positions for expiring put contracts on Micron, accepting a hard deadline to be right before a stock up 550% in a year reports earnings in hours.
